success_demo: Relay detects that the developer is absent from mouse/click/keyboard/tab activity, then turns on autopilot and hands the task to relay-resume.
scripted_arc: Presence monitor starts and records mouse, click, keyboard, and tab visibility signals.
Developer starts with a sliding-window limiter for /api/checkout.
Developer abandons sliding-window because the per-user timestamp list is too complex for the demo service.
Developer switches to a token-bucket limiter with capacity 2 and refill rate 1 request per second.
A deterministic boundary test fails because the limiter does not refill at exactly 1000 ms.
Developer leaves with the failing test, and Relay resumes from the graph plus event tail.

expected_failure.reason: Boundary refill at exactly 1000 ms currently fails.

demo_beats: Presence monitor watches mouse, click, keyboard, and tab activity.
Dev session hits the checkout rate-limit boundary bug, then leaves.
Relay emits `developer_absent` and switches the demo into autopilot mode.
Guild relay-resume hands the task to the governed agent.
RocketRide runs fetch, replay, reason, edit, test retry, PR, and notify nodes.
The PR explains the inherited blocker and the token-bucket boundary fix.
